title: Patch the first work tape
statement: Let $d$ be a configuration with $K+1$ work tapes over an alphabet $\Gamma$, state set $P$, and fixed input $x$; let $q\in P$ and let $f_1,\ldots,f_m$ be finite fields over $\Gamma$. The resulting configuration has state $q$ and otherwise retains $d$’s components, except that on work tape $0$ the cells from the head position through the next $L-1$ cells are set to the concatenated fields separated by blanks, where $L$ is the length of that concatenation; all other tape cells retain their previous contents.
